# Extract the 'Host(s)' and 'Guest judge(s)' columns for series one through eight
hosts_series = df.loc[df['Series'].isin(['One', 'Two', 'Three', 'Four', 'Five', 'Six', 'Seven', 'Eight']), 'Host(s)']
guests_series = df.loc[df['Series'].isin(['One', 'Two', 'Three', 'Four', 'Five', 'Six', 'Seven', 'Eight']), 'Guest judge(s)']

# Split each entry by newline to get individual names, then flatten the lists
all_hosts = hosts_series.str.split('\n').explode()
all_guests = guests_series.str.split('\n').explode()

# Combine all hosts and guest judges
all_judges = pd.concat([all_hosts, all_guests])

# Remove any 'N/A' entries and count unique judges
unique_judges_count = all_judges[all_judges != 'N/A'].nunique()

answer = unique_judges_count
